subject: Fix orch-gate to pick matching claim for multi-claim sessions
description: The orch-gate.sh and orch-gate-bash.sh hooks block writes when a session has multiple active task claims (claims[0] is not the current task). The gate reads claims[0].key and checks if that task's worktree branch matches the current git branch. When a session has 3+ claims and claims[0] belongs to a different task with a different worktree, all writes are blocked even when the agent is correctly inside its own worktree. Fix: instead of checking only claims[0], iterate all claims and allow the write if ANY claim's worktree branch matches the current git branch (or the file being written is inside the task's worktree path). Files to fix: /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/hooks/orch-gate.sh and /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh — look for the TASK_BRANCH check block that does `claims[0].key`.
